title: orophea rugosa
intro: Orophea rugosa, commonly known as the Wild Peach or Peach Bush, is a plant species native to the tropical forests of India and Southeast Asia. It is valued for its medicinal properties, offering a range of health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Orophea rugosa include wound healing, anti-diarrheal, and anti-ulcerative properties, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids. These constituents contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions, including digestive issues and skin disorders.
